finding.name: Missing Authorization
finding.summary: The custom retrieve() action bypasses DRF get_object(), so the scoped queryset and IsInvoiceOwner.has_object_permission() never run for invoice detail reads.

trap: Adding a standalone check_object_permissions(request, invoice) after the unscoped lookup closes the direct read but changes not-owned invoices from the scoped 404 behavior to 403, creating an existence oracle. The route should load through self.get_object() or an equivalently scoped lookup.
must_preserve: Owners can retrieve their own invoice JSON with id, owner_id, and total_cents. Staff users can retrieve any invoice. A missing invoice and another user's invoice remain indistinguishable to ordinary users.
